title: Daniel Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Daniel 8: the ram with two horns, the male goat from the west, the little horn, and Gabriel explaining the vision.

questions.text: Where was Daniel when he saw this vision?
questions.explanation: He says that when he saw, he was in the citadel of Susa, which is in the province of Elam, and that he was by the river Ulai.

answers.text: By the great river Hiddekel
In the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon
In the royal palace of Babylon
In the citadel of Susa, by the river Ulai

questions.text: What did the ram standing before the river have?
questions.explanation: The ram had two horns; the two horns were high, but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.

answers.text: Four horns toward the four winds
Two high horns, one higher than the other
A notable horn between his eyes
Ten horns and a little horn

questions.text: In which directions did Daniel see the ram pushing?
questions.explanation: He saw the ram pushing westward, northward, and southward, and no animals could stand before him.

answers.text: Westward, northward and southward
Eastward, northward and southward
Toward the four winds of the sky
Toward the south, the east and the glorious land

questions.text: What came from the west over the surface of the whole earth?
questions.explanation: A male goat came from the west over the surface of the whole earth and did not touch the ground, and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes.

answers.text: A ram pushing westward from the river
A leopard with four wings of a bird
A male goat with a notable horn between his eyes
A lion with eagle's wings and a man's heart

questions.text: What did the male goat do to the ram?
questions.explanation: He struck the ram and broke his two horns, cast him down to the ground and trampled on him, and there was no one who could deliver the ram out of his hand.

answers.text: He drove it westward into the river
He broke its two horns and trampled it to the ground
He took its horns and wore them himself
He left it standing but took away its power to push

questions.text: What happened when the male goat was strong?
questions.explanation: When he was strong the great horn was broken, and instead of it four notable horns came up toward the four winds of the sky.

answers.text: It grew two more horns, one higher than the other
It was cast down to the ground and trampled
Its wings were plucked and it stood as a man
Its great horn was broken and four notable horns came up

questions.text: How long was it to be before the sanctuary would be cleansed?
questions.explanation: The answer given was, to two thousand and three hundred evenings and mornings, and then the sanctuary will be cleansed.

answers.text: Three hundred and ninety evenings and mornings
A time, times and half a time
Two thousand three hundred evenings and mornings
One thousand two hundred and sixty days

questions.text: Who was called by name and told to make Daniel understand the vision?
questions.explanation: Daniel heard a man's voice between the banks of the Ulai, which called and said, “Gabriel, make this man understand the vision.”

answers.text: Gabriel
Michael
Belteshazzar
The prince of the army

questions.text: What do the ram's two horns stand for, according to the explanation given to Daniel?
questions.explanation: He was told that the ram which had the two horns is the kings of Media and Persia.

answers.text: The king of Greece
The kings of Babylon and Elam
The prince of princes
The kings of Media and Persia

questions.text: What happened to Daniel after the vision?
questions.explanation: Daniel fainted and was sick for some days; then he rose up and did the king's business, and he wondered at the vision, but no one understood it.

answers.text: He wrote the vision down and told it to the king
He fainted and was sick for some days, then did the king's business
He mourned three whole weeks and ate no pleasant bread
He returned to the river Ulai to seek another vision
